caption: John Emslie, Diagram of Meteorology, displaying the various phenomena of the atmosphere (c. 1845-1860)
alt: A hand-coloured print with all kinds of weather in one landscape: a rainbow, snowy mountains, storm clouds and lightning, a waterspout, a lighthouse, a whirlpool swallowing a boat and haloes around the sun, each numbered and keyed in a table below.
bibliography: Emslie, John. Diagram of Meteorology, Displaying the Various Phenomena of the Atmosphere. c. 1845–1860, Royal Museums Greenwich, London.
title: Diagram of Meteorology, displaying the various phenomena of the atmosphere
